description: A React functional component named SessionsByOrganization that renders a responsive bar chart visualizing session counts grouped by organization name using the recharts library. It handles loading states, errors, and empty data scenarios, and features a custom tooltip for detailed info.

methods.name: truncateLabel
methods.description: Utility function that truncates a label to a maximum length with an ellipsis.

methods.name: CustomTooltip
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a custom tooltip for the bar chart, displaying organization name and session count.
